title: Why Your Balance Is Worse When You Close Your Eyes
hook: Your balance is much worse with your eyes closed.

narration.text: Your balance is much worse with your eyes closed.
Try standing on one leg with your eyes open, then closed.
It is much harder without visual input.
Your brain combines signals from your eyes, inner ear, and muscles.
Vision provides critical information about your position in space.
When you close your eyes, your brain loses that key input.
This makes your other senses work harder to keep you upright.
Did you try it? Tell us your experience in the comments.

description: Ever wondered why you wobble more with your eyes shut? It is not just you. Your brain relies heavily on visual cues for balance. Closing your eyes removes a major source of information, forcing your other senses to compensate.
topic: Why your balance is worse when you close your eyes. Try standing on one leg with your eyes open, then closed.
